title: Conflict normalization payload is invalid
detail: A conflict normalization request must specify exactly two distinct claims and substantively state aligned definitions, scope, quantifiers, smallest disagreement, agreed facts, and discriminating tests.
fix_hint: Submit a complete conflict normalization payload with all required alignment fields.

example.aligned_definitions: Both claims define S_k(x) as the truncated sum of divisor powers for k in [1, 5].
example.aligned_scope: Evaluated on square-free integers in the range [10^6, 10^12].
example.aligned_quantifiers: For all eps > 0, there exists N_0 such that the bound holds.
example.smallest_disagreement: Whether the error term is bounded by O(x^{1/2+eps}) or Omega(x^{1/2} log x).
agreed_facts: The main asymptotic term has coefficient 1.
The truncation point k=5 is identical across both formulations.
discriminating_tests: Compute explicit numerical values of S_5(10^9) with precision 10^-8.
Verify the boundary condition at x = 2^31 - 1.
